End-to-end flow: home -> GRUP FORMATI -> draft (roll+assign 11 players) -> tactic TIKI-TAKA -> enter tournament -> MD 1 OYNA -> MAÇI BAŞLAT reaches the match modal and mounts ReplayMatch. All 8 required behaviours pass.

verifications.live_clock_MMSS: [data-testid=replay-clock] shows MM:SS and advances: observed 01:38 -> 02:51 -> 08:51 as speed switched

verifications.stats_block: [data-testid=replay-stats] shows ŞUT / İSABET / XG / TOPLA % with numeric values for both sides

verifications.skip_button: [data-testid=replay-skip-button] click transitions modal to done phase within ~2s: replay-match unmounts, scoreboard shows 2 · 1, close-match-button + potm-card visible
verifications.non_zero_score_evidence: Final regulation score 2-1 confirms the underlying simulator produces goals (no longer stuck at 0-0).

critical_code_review_comments: ReplayMatch onEvent is invoked from BOTH the RAF elapsed-time effect (via visibleCount effect) and the finished-flush branch — the finished-flush inside the RAF callback calls onEvent for remaining events and the visibleCount effect will not re-fire for them since visibleCount is already events.length. This looks correct, but the same double-flush path exists in handleSkip. Both paths look safe (visibleCount is set to events.length before onEvent loop completes) but worth a quick unit test.

MatchScreen.handleCanvasEvent still lives on the parent and de-dupes by 'minute-type-text'. Since ReplayMatch now emits every event exactly once through onEvent, the de-dupe is defensive-only. Kept as-is.

MatchScreen retains `liveMinute` computed from emittedRegEvents but it's no longer displayed anywhere in the playing phase (ReplayMatch owns its own clock). Consider removing dead state to reduce re-renders.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Draft flow requires selecting a tactic BEFORE the initial roll-dice-button becomes enabled. After the first roll, subsequent spins use [data-testid=roll-dice-button-draft] (or spin-the-wheel-idle wrapper). To fill the pitch, click a pool-player then click a compatible pitch-slot; incompatible clicks deselect the player.
